page.content:
Toa, Mata Nui, and a serialized story that saved LEGO in the early 2000s.

How BIONICLE connects

  • Character: Tahu — Tahu is the Toa of Fire at the start of the BIONICLE story.
  • Location: Mata Nui — Mata Nui is the island and Great Spirit of early BIONICLE.
  • Topic: LEGO — BIONICLE was The LEGO Group's early-2000s story-driven constructible line.
  • Faction: The LEGO Group — The LEGO Group launched BIONICLE as a recovery story line.

What is BIONICLE?

BIONICLE was a constructible-action line whose Toa, masks, and island of Mata Nui carried a monthly story — and a recovery hit — when The LEGO Group needed a new kind of set.

Key threads lead to Tahu, Mata Nui, LEGO and The LEGO Group.
